title: VASP Birch–Murnaghan equation of state
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-eos workflow: it optionally relaxes a crystal structure tightly with VASP, relaxes the atoms and the cell shape at a series of fixed volumes around the relaxed one, optionally evaluates each relaxed cell with a single-point calculation, and fits a third-order Birch–Murnaghan equation of state to the volumes and energies.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose equation of state is computed.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the relaxed structure whose volume was varied, output role equilibrium_volume is a records entry containing the volume at the minimum of the fitted equation of state, output role equilibrium_energy is a records entry containing the energy at that minimum, output role bulk_modulus is a records entry containing the bulk modulus at the equilibrium volume, output role bulk_modulus_pressure_derivative is a records entry containing the pressure derivative of the bulk modulus at the equilibrium volume, and output role eos_result is a files entry containing eos.json, the settings and outcome of every calculation, the fitted volumes and energies, and the fitted values.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose equation of state is computed.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The relaxed structure whose volume was varied.

outputs.name: equilibrium_volume
outputs.description: The volume at the minimum of the fitted Birch–Murnaghan equation of state.

outputs.name: equilibrium_energy
outputs.description: The energy at the minimum of the fitted Birch–Murnaghan equation of state.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus
outputs.description: The bulk modulus at the equilibrium volume of the fitted Birch–Murnaghan equation of state.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_pressure_derivative
outputs.description: The pressure derivative of the bulk modulus at the equilibrium volume of the fitted Birch–Murnaghan equation of state.

outputs.name: eos_result
outputs.description: eos.json: every child's settings and outcome, the volumes and energies fitted, and the fitted values with residuals, RMSE and condition number.
